title: UnifiedEvaluation
description: The result of evaluate(circumstances), the unified form beside the three operations, as it serialises: the appraisal (Part B, what binds self regardless and then per other), self's signals (Parts C and D, every lawful display) and, per other, what her observed signals indicate. Straw man: the shape may change. Structure only.
$comment: The engine hands this back as an object whose readings compute on first access; this is its JSON form. `appraisal` and `signals` are absent when no self was given. Compliance reads over a track, not an instant, and is not here.

restedOn.$comment: What one other's appraisal rested on: a fact the caller asserted, a fact her signals indicated, or nothing.

evaluation.$comment: Today's two-vessel envelope over self and this other; absent when the appraisal rested on nothing.

indication.$comment: Parts C and D read backwards: the fact records her observed signals say she could be, each by the entries that say so; `consistent` compares that with her asserted fact when both are given.
